prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, late 30s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, silver-white locs cascading to her waist — full body polished azurite fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is solid stone curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted stone sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING deep midnight-blue azurite surface across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID green malachite swirls flowing through every section, high-gloss polished, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. She wears a heavy medieval iron neck ring of wide rough-forged wrought iron, closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, with a heavy iron ring at the front, snug around her neck, from which a heavy chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, runs to a huge black iron ring bolted into the wall behind the bench at head height. A heavy black wrought-iron yoke bar rests across the back of her shoulders behind her neck, a heavy iron ring at each end, her arms drawn out to both sides along the bar and her wrists locked to the two ends in heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron manacles. Her legs are pressed together and wound around from her ankles to above her knees with several turns of a heavy chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, locked at the front with a heavy iron padlock. Pose: seated upright on the stone bench with her back against the wall, facing the camera, her legs stretched forward together, her arms held out to both sides along the iron bar, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.
heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, pointed platform stiletto pumps carved from the same azurite, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full thirty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts, extra long nails in matching polished azurite.

Background: a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber, a long built-in bench of rough-cut stone blocks running along the dungeon wall, a rough stone block wall behind it with iron rings bolted into it, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the stone walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM, solid material from neck to ankle. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
